scope: P03 standalone audit and case save failure handling; source/sandbox only
defect: Failed standalone audit left phantom events which a later successful save could persist. Failed case creation left ghost cases/audits; failed updates retained nondurable patch fields and timestamps.
changes: audit appends via a replacement collection and restores prior events after save failure, preserving existing compaction bounds
createCase removes a new nondurable case if its combined case/audit save fails
updateCase restores the held case object to the snapshot taken at method entry, removing newly added properties
external execution and uncertain effect barriers unchanged; failed audit never proves an external effect did not occur

tests.runtime_integration: runMailOperation + linkThreadMessage, both imported by actual server; one synthetic message_post followed by failed audit leaves durable STARTED; retry suspends without repeating the adapter effect

mutator_audit.covered_by_prior_lots: save/compaction, remember, cursors/mail operation rows, integration, cycle begin/finish, queue/supersession, approvals and generic SMTP claims
mutator_audit.unchanged_external_update: updateAction remains used by ApprovalService.executed after external effects. Do not replace it with approval-restoring rollback; Peu SQLite effect ledger separately blocks uncertain replay.
mutator_audit.limits: Rollback snapshots the case at method entry, so it cannot undo caller mutations made before updateCase. Whole business workflows are not transactional. Cycle owner-startup failure aborts startup rather than guaranteeing all held references.
